card.name: North before Africa or America
card.fires_on: The word North right after a place preposition such as in, of, or and, in history and geography text, where it begins North Africa or North America. It also fires on the word in just before such a place.

modes.label: North in continent names
modes.description: The word North after in, of, or and, where North Africa or North America comes next.
modes.example: After the Treaty of Paris ended French imperial claims in<< North>> America, the British Empire found its authority

modes.label: In before a place
modes.description: The word in after a place or event, where a region such as North Africa is expected next.
modes.example: Algiers<< in>> North Africa fell to his navy in 1

card.writes: It pushes the model to output North and its equivalents in other languages.
